# Our World in Data

Reusable source record for datasets accessed through Our World in Data and its Grapher CSV endpoints.

OWID publishes its own work openly, but many datasets available through OWID originate from third-party providers. Those datasets retain the original provider's licence terms.

For central data management, OWID should therefore be treated as a discovery/access layer unless the specific Grapher dataset's source metadata confirms that redistribution is permitted.

Example consumer: `productivity_taxation_inequality_project`.
